description: Current (or any given) time in a list of time zones or cities: local time, date, weekday, UTC offset, difference from a home zone, day/night and working-hours flags. Plus the website's meeting planner: the 24 hours of a day in the home zone, each zone's local hour and band (work 9–17, awake 7–22, night), and the hours when everyone is in working hours. Zones: IANA ids ("Asia/Tokyo") or city names ("Mecca", "New York", "Tokyo"). Uses Node's ICU time-zone data; no network. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/world-clock/

at.description: The instant to show (ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-01-15T12:00:00Z"). Default: now.

homeZone.description: Zone the differences and the planner day are measured from. Default: the first of zones.

plannerDate.description: Planner day (YYYY-MM-DD in the home zone). Default: the date of "at" there.

zones.description: Time zones or cities, e.g. ["Asia/Amman", "London", "New York"]. The first is the home zone unless homeZone is set.

name: time_world_clock
title: World clock & meeting planner
